key_warnings_mentioned: Silent CDN Referrer Protection — 32-byte access denied with no HTTP error
JS Base URL Variable Trap — full asset URLs never appear in source, constructed from base variable
Never run broad regex on <style> blocks — minified CSS looks like empty rules but isn't
Always use absolute paths — relative paths break on subdirectory pages
CSS source order — injected <style> before <link> loses to the stylesheet
Webflow w-embed blocks are CSS in body divs, not in head, and silently destroyed by regex
SRI integrity hashes must be stripped from locally-modified files
Screen-reader accessibility clones cause doubled visible text in DOM capture
Barba.js/Taxi.js page transitions require extra care for local routing
WASM modules must be downloaded and paths updated (Draco decoder, Rive runtime)
Format-responsive textures (webp desktop vs ktx2 mobile) — download both or target one
